name: Pyromancer Brilliance raises the Flamecasting stack cap (#2155)
contract: Brilliance 570207 reads "Flamecasting can now stack $s1 additional times." Its effect 0 is aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 31 SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS, BasePoints 1 (value +2) on class mask 0x2000 (Flamecasting 804301, DBC StackAmount 5), so Flamecasting stacks to 7. Two Emberheart 680378 casts (5 stacks each, per its description) overflow the cap; before the fix AscensionPyromancer::Flames capped the count at the literal 5 (10 with Invocation of Flames) through Aura::SetStackAmount and ignored the modifier, leaving 5 stacks.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Emberheart grants its five Flamecasting stacks
